pixel: row-major from the north-west corner of the tile, ppd pixels per degree
encoding: gzip; one byte per pixel: bits 0-6 = slope / 0.5 deg (127 = no data), bit 7 = 1 if at least one of the 2x2 MOLA 128 ppd pixels has a laser shot
source: MGS MOLA MEGDR 128 px/deg (PDS Geosciences): slope by central differences (~0.9 km baseline), median of 2x2 pixels → 64 px/deg (~925 m); no data beyond ±87°
